title: Dereth Town Tour - Hoshino Fortress scratch

shots.standingOrder: Rise straight up 40 m south of the village pagoda from 3 m to 42 m with the gimbal held 10 degrees up, so the pagoda roof sinks and the fortress walls rise above it; keep 6 m from the pine behind.
shots.notes: OPENING REVEAL (drone.boom-rise, keepAim off). From 3 m over the Hoshino Town lane 40 m SSW of the octagonal pagoda, the camera rises 39 m in 16 s with a fixed +10 deg tilt toward NNE: first the three tiered pagoda roofs fill the frame, then they sink to the bottom edge while the 31 m walls, gate houses and 60 m pagoda towers of the fortress appear on the plateau 100-170 m above (terrain LOS: walls visible above z 176-190 from this column). Ground 57.7 (WBT). Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (14309.1,43196.6,61.0) end (14309.1,43196.6,100.0), min AGL 3.3 m, nearest static/building/tree 6.0 m (0x020002DA@14296,43189), peak 3.8 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Fly level due north at 10 m/s, 80 m above the plateau, over the courtyards toward the floating tower; climb rather than descend if any roof comes within 15 m.
shots.notes: AERIAL TRAVEL (drone.flyover, gimbal -25). Level line at z 252 from above the south slope (y 43340, 157 m AGL) across the fortress centre (80 m above the plateau) to y 43500: the courtyards, gates and pagoda roofs pass below while the floating Hoshino Tower in its blue haze grows at the top of the frame. Closest roof: pagoda tower 0x02001B75 top 234.7, 17 m below (19 m 3-D). shots.standingOrder: Circle the floating tower a quarter turn counter-clockwise from east to north at 75 m and level with its middle; keep 35 m from the floating blue spires.
shots.notes: SPECTRAL FX + LANDMARK (classic.orbit, assigned). Quarter orbit at 75 m around the hovering Hoshino Tower, camera at z 197 (116-154 m above the slope), from bearing 70 to 340: the four-storey Sho hall floats in 21 swelling blue spectral-fog clouds, its two floating cathedral spires either side, the ground 100 m below and the fortress walls behind it from the north. Starts at 70 deg so the east spire never blocks the view (blocked at 90 deg). shots.standingOrder: Hang straight above the fortress centre at 190 m and let the courtyard grid turn 40 degrees beneath; no translation.
shots.notes: PATTERN / TRANSITION (drone.top-down, assigned). Nadir hover at z 362 over the fortress centre (190 m above the plateau, 127 m above the gate house roof) turning 40 deg: the walled courtyards, gates and pagoda roofs read as a Sho seal, the floating tower at the top edge - the acpedia 'bird's eye showing the courtyards' view.
